coverage_notes.note: The Master Cloud Services Agreement and applicable Databricks Services restrictions and documentation are referenced but not supplied; their requirements cannot be inferred.

The disclaimer and limitation of liability are nonoperative for this activity-constraint extraction.

obligation_items.content: Include a readable copy of the attribution notices from the NOTICE text file that pertain to any part of the derivative work.

gap_ledger.reason: The paragraph's operative termination events and Databricks termination power do not fit a permitted activity. Its express duty to permanently delete the Licensed Materials and all copies also has no faithful permitted activity; deletion is not modeled as Use.
